Sea Shark Shipping Services LLC was founded in 2023 by people who have
spent their careers around ships. Between them, our founders bring more
than 20 years of combined marine experience.
We work from Khorfakkan Port and Fujairah on the UAE east coast, with
offices in Sharjah and Dubai. We supply fresh water from our own barge,
arrange crew boats and act as ship agent for owners, operators and
We keep our list of services short on purpose, so we can do each one
properly and answer quickly when a ship needs us.
